observed: V1 is a portable skill and Python evidence workflow. It has no owned long-lived coordinator, provider lifecycle, cross-harness writer fencing, GitHub card revision protocol, or OpenCode Mission Control surface.
proposed: Add an Apache-2.0 Node 22 TypeScript workspace around the preserved Python core. One daemon owns SQLite WAL and execute/query/watch. GitHub owns card intent. Providers and runners receive fenced operations. OpenCode consumes the same RPC boundary. Raw evidence and credentials stay in user state.
invariants: One writer per card and worktree; lease expiry alone never proves quiescence; writer handoff requires explicit approval for an exact frozen capsule; V1 history is not rewritten; raw evidence and credentials never enter Git; delivery readiness never implies production readiness.
verification_plan: Use schema, property, coordinator, migration, provider conformance, runner, installer, and OpenCode compatibility fixtures locally. Keep Windows/WSL, Herdr, ADE, Cloudflare, whitelabels-cex, accessibility, and independent exact-candidate journeys unverified until run live.

view.limitation: Archify is not installed in this environment, so this is a repository-verifiable Mermaid fallback rather than an interactive rendered Atlas.
